definition: The price of one contract month less another's; its sign across months is the term structure, contango when later months are dearer and backwardation when cheaper.
boundaries: 'Spread' means three things: this, the bid-ask spread (bid-ask-spread@1) and the price gap of two instruments in pairs trading (cointegration-of-two-instruments@1). Needs two contracts on one clock.
recognition: Backwardation in crude reads as tight supply now.

class_meanings.fx: The bid-ask spread is meant; a calendar spread exists only in FX forwards.
class_meanings.metal: The bid-ask spread is meant for spot CFDs.
class_meanings.commodity_cfd: The broker's bid-ask spread; term structure only through the future.
class_meanings.future: Front month less next month, the term structure.
class_meanings.perp: Perp against a dated future of the same coin, where the venue lists one.
